questions.question_text: Translate triangle T by the vector \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}.
Reflect triangle T in the line y = 0.5.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle P onto triangle T.
Enlarge triangle P with scale factor -2, centre (3, -1).
Find an estimate for the median.
Estimate the number of students with a mark of more than 20.
70% of the students pass the test. Find the pass mark.
Calculate an estimate of the mean.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
What type of correlation is seen in this data?
Use your answer to part (c)(i) to estimate the physics mark for a student with a mark of 30 in chemistry.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -3 and 1.
Write down the equation of the asymptote of the graph.
Find the coordinates of the local maximum.
g(x) = x^3 - 5x for -3 \leqslant x \leqslant 1. Solve f(x) \leqslant g(x).
$216 is shared in the ratio 5 : 1. Work out the larger share.
Luis shares some money between Ali, Betty and Clare in the ratio 3 : 4 : 6. Ali receives $171. Find the total amount of money Luis shared.
Farima invests $1400 in a savings account paying simple interest at a rate of 2.5% per year. Calculate the total amount in the account at the end of 3 years.
Calculate the value of Emir's investment at the end of 4 years.
Find the number of complete years until Emir's investment is first worth more than $4000.
Complete the table.
Find and simplify an expression for the total number of tiles in Pattern n.
Pattern k has a total of 600 tiles. Find the number of grey tiles in Pattern k.

The tiles in a pattern are put in a bag. The probability of taking a grey tile from the bag at random is 5/12. A tile is taken from the bag at random and replaced. This is repeated 3 times. Find the probability that all 3 tiles are white.

All the grey tiles from Pattern 4 are put in a bag. Two tiles are taken from the bag at random without replacement. Find the probability that one tile came from a corner of the pattern and the other did not.
The diagram shows a circle, centre O, with radius 5 cm. BA and BC are tangents to the circle at A and C. Angle ABC = 30°. Calculate the area of the shaded minor segment.
The circle, centre O, has radius 12 cm. Angle DOE = 40°. The minor sector DOE is removed. The major sector is formed into a cone by joining OD to OE. Calculate the height of the cone.
Calculate the volume of the medium board.
Find the height of the large board.
Is the medium board mathematically similar to the large board? Explain how you decide.
A is the point (-11, 7) and B is the point (8, -13). Find the length of AB.
P is the point (2, -5) and Q is the point (6, 11). Line L is perpendicular to PQ and crosses PQ at point R. The ratio PR : RQ = 3 : 1. Find the equation of line L.
Find f(5).
Find and simplify g(f(x)).
Find g^{-1}(x).
Solve h(x) = 48.
The diagram shows a sketch of the graph of y = j(x). On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y = j(x + 2).
The diagram shows the graphs of y = k(x) and y = m(x). Write k(x) in terms of m(x).
Simplify fully \frac{4x^2y}{3} \div \frac{x}{12y}.
Write as a single fraction in its simplest form \frac{1}{x-3} - \frac{x-3}{2}.
The nth term of a sequence is an^2 + bn - 5. The second term of this sequence is -3 and the third term is 4. Find the value of a and the value of b. You must show all your working.
Calculate the volume of water in the ditch.

On a different day, the ditch contains 300 m^3 of water. Water is pumped out of the ditch at a rate of 4.2 litres per second. Calculate the time taken to empty the ditch completely. Give your answer in hours and minutes, correct to the nearest minute.
Calculate the area of triangle BCD.
Calculate angle ADB.
